unit.why: A single anecdote: R. Mendel of Przemyślany travels incognito to the Maggid of Mezeritch, who recognizes him at once.

stories.start_quote: כאשר נתפרסם בעולם שמעו של הרה״מ
stories.summary_en: R. Mendel of Przemyślany travels incognito to the Maggid of Mezeritch under the name Barukh, but the Maggid greets him by name, explains that he sensed the moment Mendel decided to come, and blesses him, 'he shall also be blessed (barukh)'.

quotes: רצה הצדיק ר' מענדלי מפרימישלאן לנסוע אליו לראותו
tags.why: R. Mendel journeys to the Maggid's court
The Maggid knows the incognito visitor's identity and sensed his intention from afar

quotes: הושיט לו המגיד ידו ואמר לו שלום עליכם
tags.why: The Maggid greets a newcomer at his court
R. Mendel hides his rabbinic status while travelling
The attendant denies his master's identity

quotes: כל העולם קוראים אותי המגיד הגדול
tags.why: The Maggid of Mezeritch is a maggid, though here in the role of rebbe
A witty closing pun on the false name Barukh
One tzaddik seeks out another tzaddik
